reserveReview.rationale: The three live debt-bearing pools (WXDC, CGO, psXDC) established by the exhaustive LogInitCollateralPoolId scan now have measured weights: per-pool CollateralTokenAdapter.totalShare read at XDC block 105423347 (2026-07-27, journaled at shared/data/safety-score-v9/mechanism-measurements/fxd-fathom/2026-07-27-block-105423347.json) gives 8,708,677.23 WXDC at the delayed feed's $0.0274276 ($238,858.12), 25,407,276.93 psXDC priced 1:1 as XDC by the protocol ($696,860.63), and 0.069533 CGO at $130.553 ($9.08), totaling $935,727.82 and splitting 74.47/25.53/0.001 percent. Write-time re-open 2026-07-30: the Fathom XDC deployment registry still lists the XDC and CGO collateral pool IDs (the psXDC pool postdates the docs page and is confirmed by the on-chain scan), and the journaled block-105423347 measurement remains the latest reconciled snapshot, so the prior 100% undisclosed-weights basket is replaced by the measured three-slice split.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Journaled on-chain per-pool collateral measurement at XDC block 105423347 (2026-07-27) plus the Fathom XDC deployment registry
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Pool identities and weights are measured as of XDC block 105423347; weights drift with price moves and position flows after that block, liquidation-buffer levels are not published, and psXDC carries the protocol's 1:1-as-XDC pricing assumption rather than a market exchange-rate feed.
